response.text: My goal is to connect a few of your tools using automation. Before we start, I have two quick questions. What specific tools and applications need to be connected? What is the expected data flow or trigger-action sequence between these tools? Different domain, same core work: in Lead intake automation with n8n I used n8n, Webhooks, Google Sheets API, Slack API, and JavaScript to reduce lead entry from about 2 hours a week to under 10 minutes.
